symbols.name: participating axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of participating axes, the axes that take a butterfly step in the round.
symbols.quote: Let $D$ be the number of participating axes, and let $i$ index them (the letter $i$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: An index naming one of the participating axes.
symbols.quote: Let $D$ be the number of participating axes, and let $i$ index them (the letter $i$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: current axis length
symbols.meaning: The current recursive length of axis i: the number of entries it holds at the level processed.
symbols.quote: Axis $i$ has current recursive length $\ell_i$, a power of two dividing $2r$.

symbols.name: branch bit
symbols.meaning: The branch bit, 0 or 1, that the round writes on axis i.
symbols.quote: Let $\beta_i\in\{0,1\}$ be the branch bit the round writes on axis $i$ (the letter $\beta$ changes meaning here), and $\nu_i$ its twiddle index, an integer with $0\le\nu_i<\ell_i/2$.

symbols.name: twiddle index
symbols.meaning: The twiddle index on axis i, an integer from 0 to the half length minus one.
symbols.quote: Let $\beta_i\in\{0,1\}$ be the branch bit the round writes on axis $i$ (the letter $\beta$ changes meaning here), and $\nu_i$ its twiddle index, an integer with $0\le\nu_i<\ell_i/2$.

symbols.name: highest unprocessed bit
symbols.meaning: The position of the highest unprocessed address bit on axis i, which receives the branch bit.
symbols.quote: The bit that receives $\beta_i$ is the highest unprocessed bit $h$ of axis $i$ (the letter $h$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: address bit
symbols.meaning: The bit of axis i in still unprocessed slot v.
symbols.quote: Let $x_v$ be the bit in still unprocessed slot $v$ of axis $i$; the twiddle index is $\nu_i=\sum_{v=0}^{h-1}2^v x_v$.

symbols.name: root of unity
symbols.meaning: The root $y^{2r/\ell}$, a primitive $\ell$-th root of unity in the polynomial ring.
symbols.quote: Here $\omega_\ell=y^{2r/\ell}$ for a power of two $\ell$ dividing $2r$.

symbols.name: twiddle exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of y at an address, so that the round multiplies each record by y to the power eta.
symbols.quote: The twiddle exponent at an address is $\eta$, given by

symbols.name: quotient
symbols.meaning: The integer quotient of eta by r: the number of whole multiples of r in eta.
symbols.quote: Let $e$ be the integer quotient of $\eta$ by $r$, the number of whole multiples of $r$ in $\eta$ (the letter $e$ changes meaning here)

symbols.name: remainder
symbols.meaning: The remainder of eta on division by r, from 0 to r minus 1.
symbols.quote: Likewise $\delta$ is the remainder (the letter $\delta$ changes meaning here)

symbols.name: coefficient
symbols.meaning: The coefficient of y to the power j in a record.
symbols.quote: Multiplying by $y^\delta$ moves each coefficient $c_j$ of $y^j$ to position $j+\delta$

symbols.name: parallel butterfly
symbols.meaning: The operator that applies H_0 on every participating axis.
symbols.quote: The parallel butterfly $\mathcal{B}$ applies $H_0$ on every participating axis.

symbols.name: monomial operation
symbols.meaning: The operator that multiplies each record by y to the power eta at its address.
symbols.quote: The monomial operation $\mathcal{M}_\eta$ multiplies each record by $y^\eta$ at its address.

relations.quote: A transform round computes one stage of the [multidimensional transform](multidimensional-transform.md): every participating axis takes one butterfly step at once, then the twiddles are applied.
A transform round computes its butterfly by the [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md), which applies $\mathcal{B}$ in one pass.
